def main(employee: str, personal_message: str) -> dict:
	emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee", employee)
	to_email = emp.personal_email or emp.company_email or emp.user_id
	if not to_email:
		frappe.throw(f"Employee {emp.name} has no email on file.")

	template = frappe.get_doc("Email Template", "Onboarding Welcome")
	context = {
		"employee": emp,
		"portal_link": frappe.utils.get_url("/onboarding-documents"),
		"personal_message": personal_message,
	}
	subject = frappe.render_template(template.subject, context)
	message = frappe.render_template(template.response, context)

	frappe.sendmail(
		recipients=[to_email],
		subject=subject,
		message=message,
		now=True,
		reference_doctype="Employee",
		reference_name=emp.name,
	)
	return {"sent_to": to_email, "subject": subject}
description: Sends the 'Onboarding Welcome' email to a newly created Employee, with a short personal message and a link to the document-upload portal. Call this exactly once, after the Employee record exists. `personal_message` should be 2-4 warm sentences built only from facts already gathered about this hire (role, department, start date) — never invent details. Returns the recipient address and rendered subject.
name: send_onboarding_welcome_email
summary: Renders the Onboarding Welcome email template and sends it via frappe.sendmail.
title: Send Onboarding Welcome Email

def main(employee: str, salary_structure: str, posting_date: str = None) -> dict:
	as_of = posting_date or frappe.utils.today()
	slip = frappe.call(
		"hrms.payroll.doctype.salary_structure.salary_structure.make_salary_slip",
		source_name=salary_structure,
		employee=employee,
		posting_date=as_of,
		for_preview=1,
	)

	ssa = frappe.db.get_value(
		"Salary Structure Assignment",
		{"employee": employee, "salary_structure": salary_structure, "docstatus": 1},
		["income_tax_slab", "company"],
		as_dict=True,
	)
	has_tax_slab = bool(ssa and ssa.income_tax_slab)
	company = ssa.company if ssa else None
	has_payroll_period = False
	if company:
		has_payroll_period = bool(
			frappe.db.exists(
				"Payroll Period",
				{"company": company, "start_date": ["<=", as_of], "end_date": [">=", as_of]},
			)
		)
	has_tax_component = any(d.variable_based_on_taxable_salary for d in slip.deductions)

	return {
		"employee": employee,
		"posting_date": as_of,
		"gross_pay": slip.gross_pay,
		"total_deduction": slip.total_deduction,
		"net_pay": slip.net_pay,
		"earnings": [{"component": d.salary_component, "amount": d.amount} for d in slip.earnings],
		"deductions": [{"component": d.salary_component, "amount": d.amount} for d in slip.deductions],
		"tax_scaffolding_complete": bool(has_tax_slab and has_payroll_period and has_tax_component),
		"tax_scaffolding_detail": {
			"income_tax_slab_linked_on_assignment": has_tax_slab,
			"payroll_period_covers_date": has_payroll_period,
			"tax_component_present_in_structure": has_tax_component,
		},
	}
description: Computes what an employee's payslip would look like for a given Salary Structure and date, using HRMS's own payroll engine — gross pay, every earning/deduction (including income tax if applicable), and net pay. Nothing is created or saved. Also returns tax_scaffolding_complete and tax_scaffolding_detail — if false, the income tax figure may be silently ₹0 due to missing setup (no Payroll Period covering the date, no tax component in the structure, or no Income Tax Slab linked on the employee's Salary Structure Assignment) rather than a real answer. Always check this before presenting a tax number as final.
name: preview_salary_slip
title: Preview Salary Slip

def main(employee: str, salary_structure: str, posting_date: str = None) -> dict:
	as_of = posting_date or frappe.utils.today()
	slip = frappe.call(
		"hrms.payroll.doctype.salary_structure.salary_structure.make_salary_slip",
		source_name=salary_structure,
		employee=employee,
		posting_date=as_of,
		for_preview=0,
	)
	slip.insert()
	return {
		"name": slip.name,
		"docstatus": slip.docstatus,
		"gross_pay": slip.gross_pay,
		"total_deduction": slip.total_deduction,
		"net_pay": slip.net_pay,
	}
description: Creates a real Salary Slip for an employee and Salary Structure, computed by HRMS's own payroll engine — but only ever as a DRAFT (docstatus=0). It is never submitted by this tool. HR/Payroll must review it in Desk and explicitly submit it themselves before it is final. Always tell the user this is a draft pending human review, never that the payslip is final.
name: create_draft_salary_slip
summary: Calls HRMS's make_salary_slip(for_preview=0) then inserts as a draft.
title: Create Draft Salary Slip

description: Extracts plain text from a Job Applicant's resume_attachment file (PDF, DOCX, scanned image, etc — with OCR fallback for scans), using Flow's own knowledge-extraction pipeline. Returns an 'error' key ('no_resume_attachment' or 'no_extractable_text') instead of throwing when there's nothing to read — if 'no_resume_attachment', resume_link is returned for reference only, since this tool cannot fetch an external URL. Never guess or infer resume content when this returns an error; say so plainly instead.
name: extract_resume_text
title: Extract Resume Text
